editorial: Nobody forces you into the role of an ordinary man whose quiet life spirals into violent redemption. What makes this action thriller unique is how it turns a suburban dad into an almost faceless blade, with every struggle played out in stark silence. Joaquin Phoenix carries every moment with almost no dialogue, turning a solitary rage into a visceral, kinetic heartbeat. If you enjoy a relentless, low‑key revenge saga that edges on psychological grit, this film will keep you glued to the screen. The pacing occasionally lurches mid‑commotion, but the visceral payoff makes it worth the brief lull.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of gritty action with a psychological edge.
